name: bwp-rw
description: UPDATE-capable DBHub connector (execute_sql_cade_rw, execute_sql_seo_rw, execute_sql_ranking_rw). SELECT + UPDATE only - the DB role cannot INSERT, DELETE or run DDL. Sign in with your company Google account; only people on the bwp_admins list get in. Install alongside bwp-core when you need to fix row state.
